## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 9/10** · safe to merge
Patched dist code cannot be inspected offline, so the regenerated hunks and the new alchemy patch rest on CI's alchemy harness and full suite; the pins themselves check out.
<sub>no findings · tests partial −1 · risk medium</sub>

Pins `effect` and every `@effect/*` package to 4.1.0, moves foldkit to 0.170 and `@yielded/agent` to beta.191, regenerates the package patches and adds a temporary alchemy patch for effect's new `crypto/*` modules. Dependency wiring is consistent and the only app change is a test fixture, so it is safe to merge on a green suite.

- `effect` catalog and overrides move to 4.1.0; `@yielded/agent` to beta.191, foldkit to 0.170
- `patches/effect@4.1.0.patch` drops the now-upstream `HttpApiClient` `NoInfer<PayloadR>` hunk
- New `patches/alchemy@2.0.0-beta.84.patch` ports effect/crypto to alchemy's `lib/` and `src/`
- `Llm.test.ts` fixture tool drops its explicit empty `Schema.Struct({})` parameters

### Before merge

- [ ] **Manual** · Wait for `Workers in workerd (alchemy test harness)` and the queued per-package test shards; they are what exercises the new alchemy patch <!-- ms:manual:wait-for-workers-in-workerd-alchemy-test-harness-and-the-queued-per-pac-ec76cf17 -->
- [ ] **Manual** · File a follow-up to delete `patches/alchemy@2.0.0-beta.84.patch` once alchemy ships the fix past beta.84 <!-- ms:manual:file-a-follow-up-to-delete-patches-alchemy-2-0-0-beta-84-patch-once-alc-55ff1c79 -->

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- No `@effect/*` resolution in `bun.lock` stays on 4.0.x, so no second effect copy remains
- No app or package imports `effect/Crypto`; only the new alchemy patch rewrites those imports
- Static production tools pass Struct parameters (`chat/tools.ts:213`, `security-audit/source.ts:51`), so the new untyped-schema rejection reached only the test fixture

</details>

<sub>`d259635` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.</sub>

<!-- maple-pr-review e6d9f2d3-eece-4aea-bb19-fd55139c7130 0 -->
## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
The only delta since the last review is a scraper test helper that reuses an existing repo idiom and still fails loudly if the fiber never exits.
<sub>no findings · tests covered · risk low</sub>

Bumps Effect and every `@effect/*` package to 4.1.0, regenerates the patches and adds a temporary alchemy patch for the `effect/crypto` move. The follow-up commit makes the scraper's retry and timeout tests advance the test clock until the send fiber exits. Safe to merge.

- `advanceUntilDone` replaces the fixed tick count, polling the send fiber per clock step
- Retry and timeout tests now stop advancing once the fiber has an exit

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- Retry policy is two jittered backoffs (~0.5s, 1s), so one 2s step wakes it (`apps/scraper/src/retry.ts:7`)
- `pollUnsafe()` is `undefined` while running, matching its other uses (`apps/alerting/src/scheduled.test.ts:116`)
- Same `Effect.repeat({ until, times })` idiom already used (`apps/ai/src/platform/model-call-span.test.ts:837`)

</details>
